claims.note: Vendor's own GLM-5.2 developer docs; primary and authoritative on its own product. The SOTA-among-open-source claim is a self-interested vendor positioning, but it is corroborated directionally by s2's independent near-frontier benchmark numbers (74.4% vs Opus 4.8 75.1%, ahead of GPT-5.5 72.6%).

Independent third-party benchmark review (Labellerr) carrying the load-bearing numbers 74.4/75.1/72.6. Secondary relative to the original benchmark, but credible and independent of the vendor; consistent with s1's directional SOTA framing.

Independent practitioner (Simon Willison) reporting the 753B parameter, 1.51TB size, dated same day as the release. Credible and independent of the vendor; size is consistent with the lineage (GLM-5/5.1) it explicitly compares against.

reason: Every load-bearing claim rests on an authoritative source, and no claim sits solely on a non-authoritative, single-origin, uncorroborated source. The vendor SOTA claim (s1) is corroborated directionally by independent benchmark numbers (s2); the benchmark numbers (s2) and the model size (s3) come from sources independent of the vendor. Sound.
